mapper.select: /*selectSellerMdCmBuyerCatalogAlterPop*/ SELECT A.ITEM_NO AS ITEM_NO , DECODE(A.ITEM_STATUS, 'N', '진행 가능 상품', 'P', '단종', 'Q', '일시품절') AS ITEM_STATUS , A.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION , A.MAKER_NAME , A.MAKER_PART_NO AS MAKER_PART_NO , A.QUALITY AS QUALITY , (SELECT TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE='M001' AND CODE=A.ORIGIN_CODE) AS ORIGIN_TEXT , A.MIN_DELIVERY_LT AS MIN_DELIVERY_LT , A.MAX_DELIVERY_LT AS MAX_DELIVERY_LT , A.MAKE_LT AS MAKE_LT , A.USER_PRICE AS USER_PRICE , A.PRINT_OPT_PRICE AS PRINT_OPT_PRICE , A.ITEM_QTY1 AS QTY1 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE1 AS PRICE1 , A.ITEM_QTY2 AS QTY2 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE2 AS PRICE2 , A.ITEM_QTY3 AS QTY3 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE3 AS PRICE3 , A.ITEM_QTY4 AS QTY4 , A.ITEM_QTY_PRICE4 AS PRICE4 , A.REMARK REMARK , DECODE(A.IMG_NAME, NULL, 'NO_IMG', '/attfiles/'||A.IMG_DIR||'/'||A.IMG_NAME) AS IMA_NAME , DECODE(A.STATUS, 'S', '요청', 'C', '게시', 'B', '반려', 'R','게시', 'A','보관', 'D','삭제','V','추천') AS STATUS , NVL(A.D_REMARK, ' ') AS D_REMARK , NVL(A.B_REMARK, ' ') AS B_REMARK , DECODE(NVL(A.MIN_ORDER_QTY,0),0,1,NVL(A.MIN_ORDER_QTY,0)) AS MIN_ORDER_QTY FROM PRMTITEM A WHERE A.ITEM_NO = #{st_item_no}
